test_RESERVED_NOT_EVALUATED.note: reserved for wave 16; this spoke spends ZERO scored runs and never builds or evaluates it

banks.maze_disjointness: train and val mazes come from disjoint generator seed blocks, so every val maze is a random maze never seen at train and a within-maze lookup cannot transfer

drivers: step_ref (rules-written, set-based state, no array of trits)
judge_ref (the w9 second replay, driven from inst.start over prefix+action; it never sees s_t)

ACCEPT_2_no_impossible_example.definition: an example is IMPOSSIBLE iff no emission exists that the exact transition judge accepts; this audit constructs the accepting emission for every row and checks the judge takes it

stratified_bank_train.note: fraction of transitions the engine makes ILLEGAL under RULES A+B that would be LEGAL under RULE A alone.  REPORTED COLUMN, never an abort condition.

stratified_bank_val.note: fraction of transitions the engine makes ILLEGAL under RULES A+B that would be LEGAL under RULE A alone.  REPORTED COLUMN, never an abort condition.

natural_distribution_train.note: fraction of transitions the engine makes ILLEGAL under RULES A+B that would be LEGAL under RULE A alone.  REPORTED COLUMN, never an abort condition.

natural_distribution_val.note: fraction of transitions the engine makes ILLEGAL under RULES A+B that would be LEGAL under RULE A alone.  REPORTED COLUMN, never an abort condition.

ACCEPT_4_rule_b_bites.which_is_which: the stratified bank caps rows per WORD TUPLE, which is what gives the rare configurations enough rows to score; the natural distribution is a uniform sample of (reachable state, action) pairs.  Both are printed; neither is a gate.

holdout.cap_rule: uniform seeded subsample per class; every arm on a row sees the same rows

next_state_code.why_this_matters: the emission target is a SMALL DISCRETE SET.  A random projection of a few dozen well-separated points into a handful of dimensions preserves their separation (Johnson-Lindenstrauss), so a RANDOM-ATOM store can be decodable even though its content was never fitted.  That is why the charter-C controls are measured here rather than assumed, and why they are part of the selection bar.

config_A.selection_rule: val `exact` on the `seen` row only; the held-out rows and the rollout row were not consulted.  Ties broken by the fewest read floats.
config_A.bar: seen >= 0.90 AND every charter-C control collapses on `seen` (control <= CLU - 0.15)

frozen_codec.objective: per-block softmax cross-entropy on the next-state code; no request, no arm, no judge enters the loss

clu_ledger.byte_convention: deployed bytes = 4 x (atom floats + address-book floats), the object that produces a read; the float64 sufficient statistic is what buys EXACT deletion and is declared beside it, never netted in

matched_parameters.target_definition: the CLU's READ-PATH float count = store atom floats + address-book floats.  The float64 sufficient statistic is printed separately and is NEVER matched.

within_maze_raw_r1.built_from: the VAL mazes' NATURAL-distribution rows -- a different sample of the same mazes, so the scored row is not in the table by construction
within_maze_raw_r1.WARNING: this is NOT transfer.  It is printed only as the ceiling a lookup reaches when the maze REPEATS, so the cross-maze floor can be read against it.  Every scored maze in this harness is a random maze never seen at train.

ROLLOUT.route_length: the FULL optimal route per maze (mean 44.1 steps)
ROLLOUT.action_source: the engine's own optimal route; no arm chooses the actions, so a rollout generated correctly at every step reaches the goal within budget by construction
ROLLOUT.chaining: the state fed to step t+1 is the ARM'S OWN generated state, never the engine's; the moment a step is wrong the rollout is dead and nothing re-synchronises it

ROLLOUT_L8_DIAGNOSTIC.note: a DIAGNOSTIC, never the scored rollout row: an 8-step prefix of a ~45-step optimal route cannot reach the goal, so `validity` is 0 for every arm by construction and the readable number is `all_steps_exact_rate`.

DELETION.note: colour 1 is an ordinary TRAIN colour; the value HOLD-OUT colour 4 is already absent from train and could not be deleted from it
frozen_objects_declared_outside_the_dele: w9_harness state encoder (conv AE on maze images)
DELETION.post_deletion_adaptation: the head's retained statistics A and Mx are downdated and the SAME closed form is re-solved.  Light and DATA-FREE -- no pass over the retained pool, no item kept.  NOT 'no changes'.

clu_downdate_receipt.mechanism: S_k -= x x^T, t_k -= x, n_k -= 1; the atoms are re-derived from the statistic and the address book is carried across the basis change by W_k <- W_k R_k, R_k = U_k^T U'_k. The pool is never touched.
clu_downdate_receipt.mechanism_head: A -= Phi_d^T Phi_d, Mx -= Phi_d^T X_d, then the same closed form is re-solved; the pool is never touched

store_scoped_exactness.statement: the store after deletion equals the store fitted without the rows, per-well sufficient statistic S_k

rival_retrain_without_cost.passes_over_retained_data: all of them -- the whole surviving pool is re-read every batch
